flow cytometry assay.sample_type: heparinized whole blood or cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells
flow cytometry assay.readouts: frequencies of T cell and innate cell populations; activation status markers

evidence.quote: Flow cytometry analysis was done on either heparinized whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs.

name_in_paper: Zostavax®-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 ELISPOT
enzyme-linked immunospot assay.readouts: spot-forming cells for IFN-γ, IL-4, or IL-21 after stimulation with VZV cell lysate or VZV HLA-A2-restricted peptide pool

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Cryopreserved cells (3–5×10 5 /well) were resuspended in RPMI 1640 + 10% human AB serum (Sigma Aldrich), penicillin, streptomycin, L-glutamine and 2-mercaptoethanol and added to each plate, stimulated with either media alone, 0.25 μg of VZV cell lysate (Meridian Life Sciences - Strain Ellen grade II detergent free) or VZV HLA-A2-restricted peptide pool (ILIEGIFFV (Ribonucleotide reductase subunit 2 ( Chiu et al., 2014 )), DLLYFVCLGV (ORF34; previously identified in Ahmed laboratory), ALWALPHAA (IE62 ( van der Heiden et al., 2009 )), SLPRSRTPI (IE62 (Frey et al., 2003)) and SAPLPSNRV (IE62 (Frey et al., 2003))).

name_in_paper: Zostavax®-specific and total IgG B cell ELISPOT
enzyme-linked immunospot assay (2).sample_type: freshly prepared peripheral blood mononuclear cells
enzyme-linked immunospot assay (2).readouts: numbers of VZV-specific and total IgG-secreting B cells

evidence.section: Zostavax®-specific and total IgG B cell ELISPOT
evidence.quote: Freshly prepared PBMCs were resuspended in complete FBS media at 1×10 7 /ml and added to each well, followed by threefold dilution and then incubated overnight at 37°C.

enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay.readouts: VZV-specific IgG and IgA antibody titers against VZV cell lysate or VZV glycoprotein-only protein

evidence.quote: Plasma samples were serially diluted in blocking buffer and incubated for 1.5 hr at room temperature.

real time polymerase chain reaction assa.readouts: VZV DNA detection and copy number from ORF63 amplification

evidence.quote: Amplification was performed with a RotorGene (RG-3000) real-time PCR System or the Bio-Rad CFX96 real-time PCR system, depending on availability.

polymerase chain reaction assay.readouts: confirmatory and more sensitive detection of VZV DNA ORF63 amplicons

evidence.quote: In order to increase the sensitivity to detect VZV DNA ORF63, and to verify the PCR products having the same DNA sequence of VZV ORF63, nested PCR analysis was carried out on 1/40 of the volume of PCR product that did not initially contain detectable VZV DNA.

amplicon sequencing assay.sample_type: PCR amplicons from random positive whole blood samples
amplicon sequencing assay.readouts: sequence at ORF62 codon 958 to distinguish vaccine strain VZV from wild type varicella

evidence.quote: The type of VZV DNA detected was identified on random positive samples by partial sequencing of amplicons to include codon 958 of ORF62, which distinguishes vaccine strain VZV (V-Oka) from wild type varicella (Gomi et al., 2002).
Luminex assays were performed with the Beadlyte Human 10-Plex Multi-Cytokine Detection System (Upstate).

cytometric bead array assay (2).readouts: cytokine and chemokine concentrations including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10

evidence.section: In vitro stimulation of PBMCs with Zostavax®
evidence.quote: Cell-free culture supernatants collected were analyzed for cytokines and chemokines, including IL-6, TNF, CXCL8, CCL2, CXCL9 and CXCL10 using Cytokine Bead Array (CBA) kits (BD Biosciences, San Diego, US)
Samples, after quality control, were hybridized on Human U133 Plus 2.0 Arrays (Affymetrix).

metabolomics by mass spectrometry assay.readouts: metabolite peaks by mass-to-charge ratio and retention time under positive and negative electrospray ionization

evidence.quote: Mass spectral data were collected with a 10-minute reversed phase gradient on a Thermo Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher, San Diego, CA) set to record from mass-to-charge ratio (m/z) 85 to 2000.
Metabolite confirmation was performed with tandem MS-MS experiments on Thermo QE HF, Orbitrap Fusion, or Finnigan LTQ FT Ultra mass spectrometers.
